evidence_against: FALSIFICATION FIRST / VERIFIED safeguards — The supplied implementation is not indiscriminately using outcomes as predictors. Its explicit feature lists exclude path_completed, reach/X and the named curve-progress proxies. The pipeline fits its imputation, scaling and logistic model on training data. It validates a one-to-one merge, rejects empty split lists and explicitly labels smart_degen_count secondary. These safeguards weaken any blanket allegation that all observed discrimination must be direct target leakage. No supplied run establishes whether the remaining qualifications materially alter metrics.

REJECTED inference — path_completed is explicitly a chain-reading lifecycle-completion label, not profitability, sellable survival or a realizable 5x/10x multiple. A future outcome can legitimately serve as a target; its post-decision occurrence is not itself feature leakage. The unresolved questions are predictor availability, training-label maturity, sample selection and whether the target answers the economic question. Even perfect graduation classification would not establish executable alpha.

REJECTED description of the present experiment — A first-sighting/post-launch feature table is not a demonstrated prelaunch opportunity set. The script does not verify launch identity or require a launch clock, and a row timestamp is not field availability. Likewise, immutable historical chain events could support a declared retrospective replay, but a later dataset revision or vendor annotation cannot prove original contemporaneous discovery, receipt or issued use.

CONFLICTED — The script joins on mint within its declared Solana/pump.fun source scope; it does not independently verify chain, pool or venue identity. It selects from available feature rows and an inner label join, then excludes null targets during evaluation. Counts alone do not explain unmatched or censored candidates. These operations may be appropriate for a limited descriptive replication, but cannot certify a complete minted-token, dead-token or investable economic denominator. Actual bias and its magnitude remain UNKNOWN.

SUPPORTED adverse baseline, with transfer rejected — ROUND2_TERMINAL_RESEARCH_DECISION.md reports zero of 11 reload policies and zero of three liquidity cohorts beating HOLD in its 35-symbol price/volume study, with survivorship and universe fragility. That is a scoped negative result, not a wallet/G2 comparison or a microcap executable-exit test. Its event anchors cannot be pooled with Trenches tokens as independent evidence. Earlier Goal5 and ARP02/03 Sol outputs are prior analyses, not independent microcap replications; their warning and ETHBTC statistics cannot supply missing Alpha performance.

FALSIFIER NOT MET — No supplied experiment jointly demonstrates licensed source custody, original first-known availability, uncontaminated temporal/operator holdouts, a non-survivor denominator, whole-position executable economics and net improvement over frozen G2 plus trivial controls. This absence does not prove such evidence does not exist elsewhere. Conversely, source absence makes the new-model claim untestable; it is not a measured negative return or automatically a repository defect. Qualified prospective after-cost underperformance would reject the tested economic claim, while missing evidence leaves it UNKNOWN.
evidence_for: VERIFIED, supplied-text scope only — The packet labels its archive head dbfdad9cb23c04935e63f1bdada672903921781c and supplies trenches_point_in_time_ablation_v1.py with declared SHA-256 5e08c64da69448126e825793333071e4dfc766f48fae9df329d0e22a864cbf6c. These identifiers were not independently authenticated or recomputed. VERIFIED below means static semantics or arithmetic from the supplied text, not current repository truth or executed behavior.

VERIFIED — Full public code path: main reads three local files, deduplicates feature rows by mint, inner-joins only mint/path_completed with one-to-one merge validation, casts the target to float, reads train/test membership sets, selects numeric features on the complete merged panel, then evaluates the two subsets. evaluate removes null targets, casts labels to integers and fits median imputation, scaling and logistic regression on training data. It reports average precision, ROC-AUC and top-ranked precision/lift/recall. These are lifecycle discrimination statistics, not execution or wealth measurements.

VERIFIED — The design contains 30 candidate G2 fields and one source-captured G3 field, smart_degen_count. Three arms are defined: G2_ONLY, SOURCE_CAPTURED_G3_ONLY and their combination. Reported top fractions are 1%, 5%, 10% and 20%; actual selected columns and scores are absent. Requiring at least 500 labeled rows in each subset and two target classes does not establish operator independence, power or prospective validity.

VERIFIED against the supplied October audit — C1 remains visible: timing_audit reports negative ages and reach timing but does not gate allowed G2 fields against decision-time derivability. C2 remains visible: numericize uses full-panel non-null counts and uniqueness before train/test selection, although the subsequent imputer/scaler/model are fitted on training only. C5 remains visible: nonempty membership sets and one-to-one merging are checked, but train/test/embargo disjointness, chronology, operator grouping and full-cohort reconciliation are not asserted in this script. These are confirmations of known qualifications, not new market findings.

VERIFIED / UNKNOWN distinction — The supplied script logs hashes for its three input files but does not load or verify MANIFEST.json or an HF revision. The October C3 report describes mutable resolve/main downloads in an existing workflow; that workflow's current contents are not supplied. Current downloader behavior cannot be independently confirmed, and an external source-admission layer could exist.

VERIFIED, narrow incremental observation I1 — main explicitly uses features.drop_duplicates('mint', keep='first') when decision_ms is absent. Thus the retained record can depend on file order rather than a verified first-decision clock. This is a reachable PIT-admission weakness in the supplied code path, not evidence that the actual source omitted the column, that live results were corrupted or that a new repair would improve returns.

SUPPORTED, source-document claims only — CLEAN_G3_SOURCE_CAPABILITY_MATRIX_v1.json states that the older decoded trade files have zero-mint intersection with the 85,442 capture mints, preventing raw current-token wallet reconstruction from that release. It explicitly distinguishes smart_degen_count from reconstructed AS-OF wallet quality. The native Pump event alternative is conditional on a separate prior-wallet ledger with already-matured outcomes and entity adjustment. Those underlying trades and ledgers are not supplied here.

SUPPORTED, not independently reproduced — The Trenches screening documents report PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 restrictions, a 69.09-hour capture gap, 1,225 negative-age first sightings with minimum -27.6723 seconds, unavailable reach fields at the decision cutoff, and a degenerate separate y_theta_70 target. These justify bounded source QA, not a conclusion that every G2 field is invalid. Neither the degenerate target nor reach fields are used as predictors in the supplied ablation.

SUPPORTED / CONFLICTED metadata disposition — RugPull1K's creator reportedly describes 1,028 projects, CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms and a lifecycle-midpoint cutoff, while the viewer advertises approximately 935.8k rows in one column. This is an unresolved representation/schema conflict, not verified evidence of 935.8k projects. A midpoint depending on the eventual lifecycle endpoint cannot establish launch-time availability. Borderline-case exclusions also leave population prevalence uncertain. The source remains metadata/methodology only for this review; commercial training, live use and trainable schema are not admitted.

SUPPORTED — The capability map treats Chain of Title as supporting creator/funder provenance rather than wallet-profitability truth, distinguishes the frozen CC0 deposit from later live API terms, and describes MELT as noncommercial supporting methodology. The reported October access anomaly does not prove global deletion or current availability. RED-COHORT buyer-flow findings and other vendor annotations are not full-position sellable-return results.

SUPPORTED, limited combined-gate scope — The November 5 source-feasibility report describes 18 capabilities: 11 AVAILABLE_NOT_PIT, six MISSING and one UNSAFE, with no verified microcap exit fills under that particular combined inventory. Its registry JSON and actual execution evidence are not supplied for independent inspection. CAPITAL_COMMAND_DURABLE_BRIDGE_V1.json is explicitly design/integration-pending and economic-edge-unproven. Neither document establishes that every upstream source is useless or that no qualified private evidence exists elsewhere.
hypotheses:
TEST 1 — Narrow decision-clock admission check; unexecuted specification, not a write request.
Owner/source: the existing Alpha experiment owner identified in the public documents; research/api_agent/meme_alpha/experiments/trenches_point_in_time_ablation_v1.py::main. Current private Alpha implementation and ownership qualification are not independently established.
Incremental observation I1: when decision_ms is absent, main silently substitutes file-order deduplication for earliest-decision deduplication. This is an additional, specific edge case relative to the October audit narrative, not a newly demonstrated production incident. It affects the admissibility of a first-sighting/PIT claim; a descriptive lifecycle analysis could legitimately have a weaker clock contract.
Adversarial fixture: two records for the same mint with different feature values, no decision_ms, and reversed file orders. The supplied selection branch retains different records. A PIT-qualified result should instead identify the decision clock as UNKNOWN rather than certify either record as the earliest eligible observation. Additional clock fixtures would cover null and invalid decision timestamps without inventing replacement times.
Positive control: valid numeric decision timestamps, known first-availability evidence and an unambiguous earliest record should produce the same selected record under input permutation. Passing this control would not establish field-level availability or economic edge.
Falsifier/NULL condition: if an existing authenticated upstream owner contract already requires and validates decision_ms before this script can receive data, an additional implementation repair may be redundant. That upstream contract is not supplied.
Rollback specification: discard an unsuccessful experimental validation variant and retain the original frozen artifact for reference; do not overwrite historical results or reinterpret clock-unknown rows as admitted. Critical path: inspect the existing public input contract before considering any change. Cost: a few synthetic selection fixtures require no dataset acquisition, GPU or additional API call; actual CPU time, labor and CI cost are unmeasured. No test, patch or workflow dispatch was performed or requested.

TEST 2 — One bounded source-custody and PIT reproduction of the existing ablation, not another Alpha model or wrapper.
Owner/source: existing Alpha owner; trenches_point_in_time_ablation_v1.py::{main,numericize,timing_audit,evaluate}, CLEAN_G3_SOURCE_CAPABILITY_MATRIX_v1.json and the October public code crosscheck. This test concerns the already documented C1/C2/C3/C5 questions, not four newly discovered vulnerabilities.
Cheapest source-first step: offline examination of any already-retained, lawfully usable public revision-specific receipt binding the source commit, actual file hashes, MANIFEST expectations, license text, schema, split and clock evidence. The supplied packet does not contain those underlying source files or receipts. If they do not exist in the permitted public evidence, the result is WAIT_SOURCE, with no fitting, scan or provider call.
Bounded hostile checks: (1) a feature block whose derivability or receipt time is after the decision must not qualify as an early feature; (2) changing holdout values must not change training-derived feature eligibility—for example, 99 usable training values plus one holdout value can meet the current global 100-value minimum while training alone cannot; (3) overlapping train/test token IDs, operator groups or training outcomes extending across the test boundary must be detected rather than treated as independent evidence; (4) a manifest mismatch or later source revision must not authenticate earlier availability; (5) a future wallet-quality label or constant/permuted wallet-count control must not be credited as clean contemporaneous wallet intelligence. All are proposed fixtures, not executed results.
Positive control: a legally usable, correctly hashed, fully time-bound cohort with disjoint groups and mature training labels should retain its declared denominator and frozen preprocessing. With uncertain availability A and decision D, conservative admission requires the latest possible A to precede the earliest possible D; overlapping bounds remain UNKNOWN. No numerical bounds are supplied here.
Use the existing three arms only for their declared lifecycle/source-annotation question. A clean-G3 claim additionally requires actual current-token self-initiated buyer events, prior wallet outcomes already matured at the cutoff, and pre-cutoff entity evidence. Common funding alone is not proof of common control. Routers, pools, transfers, dust and creator-seeded activity require exclusions. Chronological evaluation must purge crossing outcome windows and retain an untouched operator-group holdout. A Solana-only result cannot establish cross-chain generalization.
Rollback/falsifier: preserve the original comparison as reference and keep revised logic developmental until evaluated on an untouched future cohort. If existing qualified receipts already close these gates, the additional integrity work is NULL. If qualified wallet increments disappear against unchanged G2 and trivial controls, reject that tested increment rather than retune on the holdout. Critical path is source/legal and buyer-ledger availability, not model capacity. Small offline QA is the proposed limit; runtime, labor and full replay cost are UNKNOWN. No new workflow, model training or repository operation is authorized.

TEST 3 — Conditional whole-position economic falsification using existing sellability/outcome ownership; paper-only and presently source-blocked.
Owner/source: existing Alpha sellability #98 and outcome #77 roles, with EDGE #1530 economic accounting as documented publicly. Anchors are the source-feasibility report's P0-B2 and CAPITAL_COMMAND_DURABLE_BRIDGE_V1.json::{controls,baselines,acceptance}. The actual sellability implementation and scoring function are not supplied; no function name, private runtime access or operational readiness is inferred. The public Trenches evaluate function is only a lifecycle comparator, not an exit engine.
Scope: one preregistered chain/venue cohort and one already-authorized paper notional, comparing unchanged G2 with one source-qualified wallet increment and frozen trivial controls. Actual notional, primary horizon, selection budget and risk-utility functional are UNKNOWN and are not selected here. Constant/no-wallet ranking, a simple lawful liquidity/momentum filter and an appropriately defined no-trade/HOLD paper comparator would distinguish wallet information from base rates and capital-path exposure. The current top-percentile summaries are not an issued selection policy.
Retain every first-eligible candidate, including rugs, dead or delisted tokens, zero-liquidity observations, unissued signals, unavailable features and censored outcomes. Compare paired admitted cases while separately reporting full-cohort coverage and abstention; do not manufacture uplift by discarding difficult exits.
Execution evidence must bind exact chain, mint/contract, pool, route, quote asset, decision/receipt time and the entire hypothetical position. Require size-dependent executable depth, quote age, spread, fees, slippage/impact, gas, token buy/sell taxes or transfer restrictions, relevant MEV, LP state/changes and route failures. A lock, small successful sale or sum of competing route quotes is not proof of whole-position capacity. Shared-pool capacity cannot be independently reused across simultaneous positions. Later LP changes may be outcomes, not early features. Historical fills, if already independently evidenced, remain distinct from depth-based paper estimates; no transaction is part of this test.
Requested outcomes are due-only 1d/3d/7d/28d paper observations. The recipe also mentions 30d; 28d and 30d must not be silently substituted. Entry, exit, maturity and missing-price conventions require a frozen contract before evaluation. Failed execution retains the evidenced residual quantity and incurred costs; an unknown route is not an invented fill, zero profit or automatic total loss.
Measure paired net terminal liquidatable wealth in the exact declared quote unit, drawdown, capacity, false-selection losses and feasible missed-upside opportunity cost. Numerical decision divergence, false-positive/false-negative costs and incremental utility are currently UNKNOWN. A lifecycle false positive is not automatically a rug loss, and an omitted price winner is not automatically attainable missed profit.
Falsifier: failure to outperform unchanged G2 after evidenced fees, latency, slippage, failed routes and re-entry/opportunity costs rejects the tested economic claim. Missing legal, delivery or full-size evidence instead leaves it unidentifiable. Rollback means retaining frozen baselines and original outcome records and discarding an unsupported challenger claim—not resetting starting capital or rewriting history. Critical path: qualified source and capacity receipts through existing owners. Actual prospective coverage, runtime and cost are UNKNOWN; recipe minute estimates are not measured costs or spending authority. No private data export, new simulator, scheduler, paid call or portfolio action is proposed.
